decided_by.quote: It is possible that these may vary from module to module for students, so it is important that expectations are made clear in each module and that students are aware of these.
This can take the form of a GenAI Statement that you include in your course syllabus, in Canvas, and/or in assignment briefs.

What is considered appropriate use of GenAI can vary across disciplines or even from module to module as this may be dependent on learning outcomes and what is being evaluated in a particular assessment.
